description: Get the VERBATIM text of the North Carolina Constitution (state constitution, not statutes) by article and section, e.g. Article I Section 19 (law of the land; equal protection) or Article I Section 25 (right of jury trial in civil cases). Give the article (1-14 or Roman numeral) and a section number to get that section exactly as the North Carolina General Assembly publishes it; give only the article to list its sections and headings (use this when unsure which section number a topic is under, such as eminent domain). Returns heading, text and link. The publisher page carries the current Constitution text without amendment history. Keyless, live.

article.description: Article number 1-14 or Roman numeral, e.g. "1", "I", "Article I".

section.description: Section number within the article, e.g. "19". Omit to list the article's sections.

name: nc_constitution
title: Nc Constitution
